messages:
cate: quick alert 1: found a plaintext JSON key for svc-legacy-ingest@redwood-prod inside an archived snapshot pulled from staging-buckets. Treat as compromised until proven otherwise.
sven: ack. any recent auth events tied to that SA?
audit-bot: flagged two token exchanges to projects/metrics in the last 48h. timestamps: 2026-02-10T18:12:00Z and 2026-02-11T02:05:00Z.
maria: we need a safe rotation. propose: create new key, store in Vault KV (transit-wrapped), roll a 10% canary to ingestion fleet, monitor, then revoke old. Also tighten RBAC (remove legacy editor bindings).
cate: agree. important: Vault cluster replicates to eu-west asynchronously; include replication-checks before revocation. vault-bot: replication lag typically ~60-90s under load. Recommend verification step: `vault read sys/replication/status` and confirm applied_index parity.
sven: infra note: will open TF PR to add `secret/ingest/legacy/v2` path and adjust iam_binding to `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` for consumers. PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1822
audit-bot: plan to export Create/DeleteServiceAccountKey events and KMS rewrap audit logs to longterm table `security.rotations_5000001234` for the canary window. Filter: `protoPayload.methodName:("CreateServiceAccountKey" OR "DeleteServiceAccountKey") AND resource.labels.service_account_id:svc-legacy-ingest`
maria: minimal staging commands I'll run and paste to PR:
```
# create new key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=svc-legacy-ingest@redwood-prod
# wrap and store in Vault
vault write transit/rotor plaintext=@new-key.json
vault kv put secret/ingest/legacy/v2 key_cipher=@ciphertext
# bump canary to 10% and smoke test
kubectl set env deployment/ingest-agent INGEST_KEY_PATH=secret/ingest/legacy/v2 INGEST_CANARY=10 -n prod
```
cate: after 20m of canary stability, promote and revoke old key. revocation command: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete OLD_KEY_ID --iam-account=svc-legacy-ingest@redwood-prod`. Keep rollback: re-enable old key if failures >5% in 10m.
compliance-bot: note: if we change KMS key ownership (BYOK) or export audit data cross-region, open compliance ticket. Otherwise attach the longterm export to the rotation ticket.
sven: owners: cate=lead, maria=runbook+rollout, infra=TF & RBAC, audit-bot=log export, vault-bot=replication check. Scheduling: staging test Mon 09:00 PT, prod canary Tue 06:30 PT, promote Tue 07:00 PT if green. I'll post calendar invite and link PR. :white_check_mark:
